subject: HOF Gen7 Core V1 PresentationHinge adversarial peer check: 3 directive gaps + 1 stale-target hardening issue
body: Consumed Manager predictor-lane dedupe and rescoped from a competing normalized-progress reference model into an independent falsification/parameter-sensitivity review of Primary Gen7 Core V1. Reviewed exact Primary artifact SHA 1eb02d62d58d8baf42c020993455c96028b5793c34136e2f4fcab63ee4b9e20e against current main 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44. Local Kotlin adversarial harness reproduces 4/4 observations: (F1) REACQUIRE is a max-speed clamp rather than critically damped correction; permitted 40ms clamped frame produced 0.22 progress one-frame correction. (F2) estimator has velocity but no acceleration/jerk state or bound; adversarial reversal changed +3.5 to -5.0 progress/s across 4ms, implied estimator acceleration -2125 progress/s^2 (visual output remains separately slew-limited). (F3) no sustained oscillation guard exists; after two partial-fold reversals in 35-65/40-60 deg sequence, 88ms after latest delivery model returned BLACKOUT_PREDICT confidence=0.8 instead of REVERSAL_GUARD. (F4) stale targetForFrame identity returns attempt=null but still carries current-attempt progress/measured data; integration hazard, not proof of stale render. Primary 100k fuzz does not assert these contracts, so its PASS is not contradicted. Independent oracle tests 11/11 incl deterministic 100k events show stricter contracts are testable but are not a competing production proposal. Clock/timebase finding explicitly deferred to rnd-gen7-clock-sol-633c75be-61e4a9d2. Recommended disposition: focused Primary V2 hardening on F1-F3; fix or explicitly fence F4; preserve other Gen7 lanes. No production writes, CI or FIELD claims.
